title: chunk@1
description: Serialized eng::world::Chunk (ARCHITECTURE.md §5.2), encoding per engine/core/world/chunk_codec.hpp (PR #4). kChunkSize = 32, kChunkLayers = 4 (ground, detail, walls, roof), kChunkFormatVersion = 1. Layers are compact: each is an object of optional 1024-entry row-major integer arrays (index = y*32 + x); an omitted array means all zeros. EntitySpawn.stable_id is computed by the loader and must NOT appear in files. content_hash (optional) is xxHash3-64 over the canonical little-endian binary serialization of the loaded Chunk (§4.5), not over the JSON. Integers only (§4.3).

overrides.description: Per-instance data merged over the archetype. The loader stores its compact sorted-key dump in EntitySpawn::overrides_json ('' when absent or {}).

entity_spawn.description: stable_id is computed by the loader (xxHash3-64 of i32 x, i32 y, i16 level, u32 spawn index; low ^ high 32 bits) and is forbidden in files.

hash_hex.description: 16 lowercase hex digits of compute_content_hash(chunk): XXH3-64 (seed 0) over u16 format_version, i32 x, i32 y, i16 level, u32 palette count + strings (u32 length + UTF-8 bytes), 4x1024 cells (u16 tile, u8 elevation, u8 flags), u32 spawn count + per spawn (str archetype, i32 x, i32 y, u32 stable_id, str overrides compact-sorted JSON or ""), u32 trigger count + compact-sorted JSON strings. All little-endian. origin is excluded.

layer.description: One layer; omitted arrays = all zeros.

tiles.description: TileId per cell (u16, index into palette; 0 = empty). Validator checks < palette length.

flags.description: Tile flags (u8): bit0 blocks_move, bit1 blocks_sight, bit2 difficult, bit3 water, bit4 climbable (climb terrain: enterable by climbing even with blocks_move), bit5 open_air (no footing, flyers only); bits 6-7 reserved, must be 0. Flags are independent: blocks_sight without blocks_move is valid (curtains, fog, tall grass), as is blocks_move without blocks_sight (glass, low fences).

trigger.description: Script hook / region. id and kind required; other fields free-form. Loader stores the compact sorted-key dump.

sides.description: Team names (sim spawn_team_name: overrides.team, else 'party' for character archetypes, 'monsters' for monster archetypes). Every combatant spawn of THIS chunk on a listed team is surprised. Each name must be the team of at least one combatant spawn in this chunk.

spawns.description: Indices into this chunk's spawns[] (the spawn index that EntitySpawn.stable_id is derived from; stable_id itself is forbidden in files). Each must name a combatant spawn (monster or character archetype).

surprise.description: R-G16 encounter surprise (docs/CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md section 8). RESERVED: no loader reads it yet; the validator warns that it has no effect. Contract for the future loader: resolve to the combatant ids (spawn stable_ids) of this chunk and pass them to sim::Combat::apply_surprise (#123) after create() and before the first command. Exactly one of sides / spawns. Not part of content_hash (the chunk decoder ignores the key).

palette.description: TileId -> tile asset id. Slot 0 is reserved for the empty tile and must be ""; all others non-empty.
